_comment: CAPABILITY MANIFEST TEMPLATE — Evaluation V2 Step 1a.  This is a .template.json and must NOT be used as a verified configuration.  Platform linux/amd64 is intentionally inlined here (not the existing arm64 manifests); both platform variants co-exist until spec decides whether to backfill arm64 into the amd64 manifest or keep them separate.  After docker build of each image, fill in imageId and reference fields with actual sha256 digests.
title: RD-Bot Evaluation V2 Capability Manifest (linux/amd64)

sharedLayers.description: pi-agent base image layer — shared by agent and oracle images.  Replace @SHARED_BASE_LAYER_DIGEST@ with the actual digest from rd-bot/pi-agent:local after build.

layers.description: Java 21 toolchain layer (from Dockerfile.java21) — openjdk-21, maven, bash, git, curl, jq, unzip, ca-certificates
Node.js 20 toolchain layer (from Dockerfile.node) — node:20-bookworm-slim + pnpm + yarn + corepack
Oracle script layer (from Dockerfile.oracle) — openjdk-17, maven, oracle verification scripts
Relay application layer (from Dockerfile.relay) — aiohttp + gunicorn + relay.py

securityConstraints: Authorization header from agent stripped; relay injects its own upstream credential
Token cleared from process env at startup

layers.description: Java 21 toolchain layer — same as agent image Java 21 layer for deduplication

step4_agent_multistage.note: Agent image uses multi-stage build: stage 1 installs java21 toolchain, stage 2 installs node20 toolchain.  Digest of combined image is AGENT_IMAGE_DIGEST.

step5_oracle.note: Oracle image extends pi-agent base with Java 17 only (see Dockerfile.oracle).  Reuses pi-agent base layer digest.

platformMigrationNote: This manifest declares platform=linux/amd64.  The repository already contains capability manifests for linux/arm64 (java17-arm64-20260730-v1.json, java21-arm64-20260730-v1.json, shared-images-arm64-20260730-v*.json).  Both platform variants co-exist until Evaluation V2 spec formally decides whether to produce a unified manifest or keep platform-specific manifests separate.  The Case Manifest (coding-benchmark-v2.template.json) uses platform=linux/amd64 to align with this manifest.
nextStep: After filling in all REPLACE_WITH_ACTUAL_* digest placeholders from the docker build outputs above, save this file as capability-manifest-amd64-YYYYMMDD-v1.json (e.g. capability-manifest-amd64-20260730-v1.json) and move it alongside the verified arm64 manifests in scripts/evaluation/docker/.
